dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Carcajou area (NTS 84F/NW) (discontinuous permafrost features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the permafrost polygon features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 580, Surficial Geology of the Carcajou Area (NTS 84F/NW).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Carcajou Area (NTS 84F/NW) (GIS data, permafrost polygon features)
